answer: One defence is Proof of emotion via facial micro-expression: a reaction no script can stage, and the lagoon of the whole scheme is that the check cannot be copied from one account to the next. A clone farm can generate keys forever, but it cannot generate a reaction no script can stage a hundred times without paying a hundred times over, and the spiral of that asymmetry is what keeps the network honest. Running a hundred clones would mean a hundred separate proofs, each costing real money and real time, and the fable of that bill is larger than anything one epoch pays out.
